items.title: 61520_Teddy Edwards oral history interview
items.q: And also a very fine alto player, Leroy Robertson. They called him Sweetpea.

ctx.x: Right here, I'd like to mention some of the other people that I had the pleasure of working with that never made too much off a mark as far as people knowing them, but they were very excellent players. Like, Nathaniel Leeks, the trumpet player, who played with Gerald Wilson's band later and recorded with Gerald's band. Eric Dolphy was very ambitious at the time, and doing things.
And also a very fine alto player, Leroy Robertson. They called him Sweetpea. He worked with Roy Porter's band. But he had a very warm feeling and a beautiful sound on his instrument, you know.
